fail.name: farmland-6
fail.problems: Near-duplicate of farmland-0: the same full-width upper field with vertical crop rows, lower field with horizontal rows, and almost identical halfway division repeat as one stamped motif in the 3x tiled layouts (shuffle 1, bottom row columns 3-4; shuffle 2, bottom row columns 1-2; shuffle 3, bottom row columns 4-5). The straight lane across y=23..25 and a few changed texture pixels do not produce a distinct composition at map zoom. Keep farmland-0 as the approved version of this composition and redesign variant 6 with a substantially different field division and crop distribution, such as three unequal rectangular fields with an offset lane; preserve that new geometry across its four seasons. Keep fields running to the edge behind only the thin boundary hedge, with all boundary crossings perpendicular to the edge. The current muted crop colours and edge-to-edge coverage are acceptable. Variants 0 and 6 have 2,123 of 2,304 pixels identical in this season (92.1%); the visible repeated composition, rather than the number alone, is the reason for failure.
